package.name: Clipboard
package.author: Peersus contributors
package.description: Clipboard text sharing with explicit permissions and optional automatic synchronization.

capabilities.clipboard.use: Send text to, and accept text from, a paired device on this extension's behalf. Reading and replacing this device's clipboard is a separate permission of the application.

exports.description: Shares clipboard text between this device and a paired device.

share.description: Sends the clipboard text to the device you chose.

send_text.description: Sends text that was shared into the application to the device you chose.

receive.description: Takes text a paired device sent and puts it on the clipboard, replacing what is there.

settings.label: Automatically synchronize clipboard text
settings.help: Opt in here and per device. New copies are sent only while this device can read the clipboard, and sensitive clips are excluded.

settings.label: Automatically send clipboard text to this device
settings.help: Requires automatic synchronization and, for this device, permission to see it, the clipboard permission and the send permission.

pages.changes: Accepting lets the application install and run this extension; it grants no extra rights over your files, devices or data.

pages.title: What this extension does
pages.explains: Clipboard asks the host to share this device's clipboard text with a paired device you choose, and can ask it to replace this device's clipboard with text a paired device sends. Optional automatic synchronization is off until you enable it here and per device.
pages.changes: After installing, 'Send clipboard text' and 'Send shared text' actions appear. Clipboard text you share leaves this device for the paired device you chose; with synchronization on, new clipboard text may be sent automatically to devices you enabled.
